The `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException` occurred during `Cipher.init` in [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r4/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L25) because the Keystore AES key was configured with `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and a 30-second biometric/device credential requirement (`setUserAuthenticationParameters`). Because user authentication was not performed prior to invoking `vault.save(token)`, initializing the cipher threw `UserNotAuthenticatedException`.

### Changes Made

In [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r4/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L27):
- Changed `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` to `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(false)`.
- Removed `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)` so cryptographic operations on the Keystore AES key do not require biometric or device credential authentication.
